title: Slack Partner Program: Build Apps, Agents & Integrations
snippet:
- ### ISV and Technology Partners
Build agents and apps that reach enterprise teams where they're already working. List on the Slack Marketplace and get platform access, partner benefits, and go-to-market support that grow with you.
- ### Consulting and SI Partners
Help customers roll out and expand Slack across their organizations. Consulting partnerships are managed through the Salesforce Partner Community.
## The more you build, the more the program invests
The Slack ISV Partner Program gives technology companies a clear path for building and growing on Slack. As you build in Slack, the partner program will invest back in you.
- ### Developer
Build custom apps for your team and learn the platform. Get access to developer sandboxes, our core APIs, and the full developer toolkit.
- ### Marketplace Partner
List your app and get discovered. Plus, get access to the partner community, roadmap visibility, a partner badge, and partner webinars.
- ### Agent Partner
Everything in Marketplace Partner, plus co-marketing, partner betas, event and advisory board access, and dedicated partner manager support for Salesforce-aligned partners. Top-tier partners get early access to advanced agentic capabilities.

We offer access to all of our Slack APIs and integration patterns for free to partners.
You get comprehensive support and resources to scale your business. This includes a powerful community of over 20 million Trailblazers, 20k Slack Community members and your peers in the Partner Blazer community.

title: Submission guidelines and requirements | Slack Developer Docs
snippet:
If you do so, you should handle payments securely and provide transparent information on your billing policy. You can select one of the following pricing models to be displayed on your app's listing page.
- **Paid:** users pay to use your app.
- **Paid with free trial:** users pay to use your app, but there's a free trial available.
- **Free and paid plans available:** users don't need to pay to use your app, but there are paid features available.
- **Free:** your app is free!
- **Included with service subscription:** the app is free so long as users have a paid plan with your service.
The [Slack Marketplace Agreement](https://api.slack.com/slack-marketplace/marketplace-terms-conditions/slack-marketplace-agreement) takes effect when you submit your app for review, and no separate agreement is required. If you intend to list your app in the Slack Marketplace, you may charge for it and offer paid plans before it's approved, including while you work toward the minimum installation requirement.

### Scope & Data access​
When developing your app for Slack, one of the most important things to bear in mind is the level of access it needs to work: the less access your app requests, the more comfortable users will feel about installing your app. From the customers’ perspective, they must give your app access for it to function and they may be reluctant to install apps that request a lot of access to their Slack data (particularly sensitive data like their message history).
- ✅ **DO** adhere to the ‘principle of least privilege’ when thinking about the scopes your app will use
- ✅ **DO** provide clear reasons for each of the scopes you include in your submitted app. Don’t just tell us what the scope does (we know that already) but rather tell us how your app uses it
- 🚫 **DON’T** include scopes in your submitted app intended for future functionality. We will only approve scopes related to functionality we can test
- 🚫 **DON’T** request legacy/restricted scopes. See here for more details

- We are unlikely to approve broad access to workspace message/file data (e.g. user token *:history scopes) without a clear use case that requires them, such as [Real-time Search](https://api.slack.com/apis/web-api/real-time-search-api/) or [MCP server](https://api.slack.com/ai/slack-mcp-server/developing/) functionality
- We are unlikely to approve use of admin* scopes by apps submitting to the Slack Marketplace who are not part of our [partner program](https://slack.com/partners)

title: Developer sandboxes | Slack Developer Docs
snippet:
The ability to provision sandboxes is a benefit offered by the [Slack Developer Program](https://api.slack.com/developer-program).
Every developer enrolled in the Slack Developer Program is eligible to provision a basic sandbox. Developers who are on a paid plan or who provide a valid payment method are able to access additional features.

If you are a member of a paid plan (the paid plan workspace must have been created at least 30 days ago, unless you're in an Enterprise organization) your sandboxes will have access to additional features. If you are not a member of a paid plan, you can also provide a payment method to access the full set of features, but note that you will not be charged.
Enter the details for your sandbox. You'll be able to choose whether you want an empty sandbox (1 workspace and 1 demo user) or whether you want to load a Slack template to your sandbox, which contains 1 workspace, 7 system-created fake users, 7 channels, and system-created threads, replies, and reactions to threads/replies. If you are part of the [partner program](https://slack.com/partners), you will have the option of choosing from additional [templates](/tools/sandbox-template-demos).

- **Other limits**:
- Discovery API enablement is not available on sandboxes unless you are part of our [partner program](https://slack.com/partners).

As part of the [Slack Developer Program](https://api.slack.com/developer-program), you'll get access to an Enterprise organization sandbox that allows you to explore all features, including automations. You'll also get early access to betas, and can develop and test apps and workflows in a dedicated, fully-featured development environment.

Any developer enrolled in the Slack Developer Program can provision a basic developer sandbox. Any developer who is either on a paid plan or provides a valid payment method for the account can also access additional features in the sandbox.
